notes.title: Wand Out releases on August 23rd! (New Trailer)
notes.content:

notes.title: Wand Out is Coming!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

It's been a while since the last Wand Out devlog, but we're back with great news. 

We're thrilled to announce that the game is finished and we're just working on the final polishing! The official release is scheduled for August. Thank you for your excitement and interest throughout the game's development.

Add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2079610/Wand_Out__A_3D_Magical_Gay_Novel/]Wand Out[/url] to your Steam wishlist and stay tuned for the release date.

notes.title: Game Progress
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714333/812e8f0941667c3785fe4f4e9999869cde49fbf2.png[/img]

Hey there!

Most of the game is done! We're currently focused on polishing and reviewing the text to ensure an amazing experience for you. Our [url=https://www.patreon.com/maledollstudio]Patreon[/url] community has been very helpful with their feedback and participation in surveys, thanks to these opinions we are getting closer and closer to a result that you will love.

Partial builds of the game are available on [url=https://maledollstudio.itch.io/wand-out-gay-novel]Itch.io[/url] for those who want to test it for free! 
For our [url=https://www.patreon.com/maledollstudio]Patreon[/url] supporters, we are uploading the complete game currently content, according to their tier. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42714333/f3569bd07f51cb83d69a0ad238a42dfea24bf773.png[/img]

Make sure to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2079610/Wand_Out__A_3D_Magical_Gay_Novel/]Wand Out[/url] to your Steam wishlist so you can stay informed on all the latest news!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2079610/Wand_Out__A_3D_Magical_Gay_Novel/

We are extremely grateful to all of you for your support and we hope you like our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/maledoll/list/58737]upcoming releases[/url]!
